name: maker-feature
what: the maker turns a red green when the scenario forces an old test to move

slice.title: Used-up items leave the list
slice.ignore: What runs out soon; the expiring list is unchanged.

baseline_prompt: Make this work in this repo: when the household uses the last of something, it no longer shows in the list of what the household has. Using the last loaf of bread takes bread off GET /items. Items with some left still show, as now. The failing test tests/test_hide_used_up.py shows it. The whole suite runs with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and must pass.
